cautions.quote: Note that this code unit does not contain the procedure CanDrinkAlcohol. This is very important and we will discuss why later.
To access default implementations, you must call the interface variable not the code unit directly.
In this example, AmericanGuest.CanDrinkAlcohol() is not valid. The code unit ARD_AmericanGuest doesn't have a procedure named CanDrinkAlcohol.
If the implementors have not implemented a GetTipAmount at this point they will receive an error.
